description: A concrete, real playable starting party mined from the engine's own example character saves (jCRPG-engine/chars/*/character.zip -> character.xml, XStream-serialized org.jcrpg.world.ai.humanoid.modifier.race.*). These 3 characters match the party size (3) recorded in the example save's desc.txt, and are treated as the default/reference starter party for the web port.
recommendation: Use these saved characters as the initial playable party instead of building a full character-creation UI first. It unblocks party/inventory/combat UI and rendering work immediately with real, valid stat data. Build the character-creation flow (race/profession picker + attribute rolling) as a later feature layered on top of the same data shapes, once the core game loop works end-to-end.

genderTypeLegend.3: possibleGenders bitmask seen on race templates (both)

notes: attributes/resistances/skills confirm the schema already captured in world_seed0_sample.json (base value 10 for a fresh CharacterCreationRules default; these 3 already have some attributes/skills raised above baseline from creation-time allocation and/or play).
genderType and pictureRoot/pictureId map directly to portrait assets (e.g. jCRPG-engine cache or resources) the UI (CharacterSheetWindow) uses for the character portrait.

webPort.approach: Ship this party JSON as the default/starter party for play.html; ItemSystem/GameLogic stubs can load it directly instead of running character creation. A character-creation UI (races/professions from characters.json) can be added afterward as an alternate 'New Game' path.
